title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. If there is no common prefix, return an empty string.
pseudocode:
1. IF strs is empty, RETURN ""
2. SET prefix = strs[0]
3. FOR i from 1 to length(strs) - 1:
4.   WHILE strs[i] DOES NOT START WITH prefix:
5.     SET prefix = prefix.substring(0, length(prefix) - 1)
6.     IF prefix IS empty, RETURN ""
7. RETURN prefix
